about_the_game:
This isn't a traditional introduction.

You're not about to play the beginning of the full game.

Nor is it a prequel.

Much less a cursory glimpse.

What you're about to experience is an alternate story...

but not a disconnected one.

Every element, every environment, every emotion that runs through you in this demo is part of the Under Rooms universe. A web of invisible threads that you'll understand later. You won't find direct answers here.

Only fragments. Shadows that follow you even if you don't look back.

This demo was built with real pieces from the full game: reimagined scenarios, intact emotions, and an atmosphere that breathes on its own. What you see and feel in this brief tour is not incidental. It's canon. Playing this demo isn't trying it out. It's just getting started. When it's over, you won't really know what you experienced. But you're going to want to understand it. And to do that, you're going to have to keep going down.

Deeper.

Closer.

Deeper.

short_description: Under Rooms Demo is a fast-paced survival exploration experience. As a rookie MEG, a young man who accepts a high-risk mission to earn a promotion and the respect of the faction, you must loot resources, complete your mission, and confront hidden horrors.
